- Requirement: "Each attempt now gives the model a fresh copy of the captured index through `GIT_INDEX_FILE`, and the script still stages and commits the accepted resolution itself." (PR description; restated in `changelog.d/5627-resolver-private-model-index.md:4` and `agents.md:2157-2164`.)
  Expected change site: `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh` — the `stage_resolver_touched_path_or_fail` function definition at lines 44-63.
  Evidence of absence: The round 1 fix added a three-line comment at the post-loop staging block (lines 2943-2945) explaining that staging runs on the real index on purpose and `GIT_INDEX_FILE` must not be set there. The function definition itself at lines 44-63 was not touched in either the original PR or the round 1 autofix commit. The function calls `git add` (line 49) and `git rm` (line 54) on whatever index the calling process has, lives before the source-repo gating at line 2304, and before `RESOLVER_MODEL_INDEX_FILE` is initialized at line 540 — a reader who finds the function by itself has no signal that it must run on the real index. `test_private_model_index_wiring` asserts loop-level wiring but does not pin the function definition's index contract. A future editor who refactors this function or wraps its call in a subshell that exports `GIT_INDEX_FILE=${RESOLVER_MODEL_INDEX_FILE}` would silently reintroduce the original #5627 failure mode: the resolution would stage into the private copy, the real index would keep its unmerged entries, and the merge commit would carry nothing.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
